method: Independent source and sealed-evidence audit plus isolated exact-source replay of the 21-condition fit audit, 24-condition specification audit, and 10-condition motion manifest covering two-way reel clearance, four latch entry corridors, pullout capture, stand arc, and both endpoint stops.
acceptance: Clockwise and counterclockwise hard-part reel cycles must each clear 73 samples, while fit evidence must encode a rounded two-way detent cam with the authored rabbit-home differential.
All four one-axis latch entry corridors must clear and retained shell pullout must block separately.
The stand must implement the authored 112-degree endpoint, clear the full deployed-to-folded arc, block both overtravel directions, and remain within the authored about-82-mm depth target.
Rigid and algebraic checks must not be represented as proof of elastic force, strain, detent feel, snap retention, tipping, strength, or cycle life.
